name: AppFlowy
description: Open-source Notion alternative in one container. Notes, docs, wikis and projects that you own.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, files, search index, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: AppFlowy web app, API, sign-in, admin console (/console) and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6101

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you type in your browser. It starts as localhost, which only works on this device. For other devices, change `localhost` to your server IP. Keep the port at 6101.

variables.name: MP_UI_AUTH
variables.description: The login for the mail viewer at /mail. Leave it blank and the app makes one on first start: username admin and a random password, saved in /mnt/cache/appdata/appflowy/data/mail-password.txt (open it with the Files app) and shown in the app log. Or type your own as `username:password`.
